outcome: Incidence of health implications on mother and child
cohort: Two groups of patients who underwent cesarean section at General Hospital 'Prim.dr A. Nakaš' in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH)
finding: A significant increase in cesarean section rates in BiH from 2007 to 2018 coincided with a statistically significant decrease in perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Complications after cesarean section were primarily subjective problems and early complications, with hemorrhages being the most common in both observed years.
